# Emerging Manager Monthly

> > Emerging Manager Monthly provides investment industry intelligence, emerging manager profiles, and a comprehensive directory connecting institutional investors with diverse asset managers.

Emerging Manager Monthly is a specialized publication and platform serving institutional investors, asset managers, and industry professionals. The site features a newsletter with market trends and manager profiles, a Diverse Manager Directory for emerging manager discovery, and industry news covering public pensions, foundations, endowments, and corporate plans.

## Key Topics

- Emerging managers
- Diverse managers
- Asset management
- Institutional investors
- Public pension plans
- Foundations and endowments
- Manager profiles
- Investment industry trends
- Manager searches and RFPs
- EMM Awards
- Diverse Manager Directory
- Industry intelligence
- Corporate pension plans
- HBCUs
- Alternative investments

## Core Products & Services

- [Emerging Manager Monthly](https://emergingmanagermonthly.com): Homepage for Emerging Manager Monthly newsletter and Diverse Manager Directory
- [Diverse Manager Directory](https://emergingmanagermonthly.com/diverse-manager-directory): Diverse Manager Directory product for emerging manager discovery
- [Advertising & Sponsorship](https://emergingmanagermonthly.com/advertise): Advertising and sponsorship opportunities for asset management firms
